what: Pattern type range ends (#![feature(pattern_types)]): rustc ast lowering (lower_ty_pat_mut) turns an exclusive end a..b into an anon const RangeSub::sub_one(b) (lower_excluded_range_end) and fills an open end with an anon const <_ as RangeMin>::MIN / RangeMax::MAX (lower_ty_pat_range_end). hir-def expr_store lowering of TypeRef::PatternType should synthesize those anon const bodies (lang items RangeSub, RangeMin, RangeMax). Until then hir-ty lower.rs reports TyLoweringDiagnostic::PatternTypeNotLowered { reason: ExclusiveEnd | OpenEnd } (no silent wrong type). Once hir-def makes them, hir-ty drops those two reasons.

history.note: already true: hir-def collect_ty_pat lowers a..b through lower_excluded_range_end (RangeSub) and an open end through lower_ty_pat_range_end (RangeMin/RangeMax), always Inclusive; hir-ty dropped ExclusiveEnd/OpenEnd (lower.rs, lower/diagnostics.rs, ColdBatch schema 6); emitter arms queued to no-fallback-tools
